title: New mmWave communications module targets the growing UAV and defence market
summary: As unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) become increasingly important for defence, infrastructure monitoring, public safety and commercial operations, attention is shifting from the aircraft themselves to one of their most critical enabling technologies: communications.
